{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Tailfin Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|pub]] operating in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It was the property of [[Jerrahg]], who also served as [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

The Tailfin Cantina was a popular drinking point. It was enjoyed both by visitors to the town, as it was strategically placed, and also by [[Lum/Legends|lum]]-drinking sailors who enjoyed private [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] tables, all the while with an interpreter of [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] providing entertainment.<ref name="BL" />

Fistfights happened occasionally with little provocation, with one of them taking place in 29 BBY because of a drunk seven-foot [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]. The situation included breaking of furniture, although the musician still played [[The Hutt Two-Step]] all the time.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>
